veranderings.voor: ná die beginpunt en die v.C.-jare
veranderings.na: ná die beginpunt, en die v.C.-jare
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: Die jare voor die beginpunt tel agteruit en nie vorentoe nie
veranderings.na: Die jare voor die beginpunt word agteruit getel en nie vorentoe nie
veranderings.rede: As written the years themselves do the counting; the passive says that we count them backwards, which is what is meant.

veranderings.voor: Op 'n tydlyn van links na regs staan
veranderings.na: Op 'n tydlyn wat van links na regs loop, staan
veranderings.rede: 'n Tydlyn van links na regs' is compressed and reads ambiguously; a short relative clause makes clear it is the direction the timeline runs.

veranderings.voor: Jy merk die gebeure op die tydlyn
veranderings.na: Jy plaas die gebeure op die tydlyn
veranderings.rede: 'Merk ... by hulle eie jare' is slightly unidiomatic for putting events onto a line; 'plaas' is the natural verb here.
'Oordra' is the idiomatic Afrikaans verb for passing on heritage; 'aangee' suggests handing an object across.

vlae.teks: 'n Speurder soek leidrade in bronne en wil ook weet wanneer iets gebeur het.
vlae.rede: The lesson opens with 'n Speurder' without saying who the detective is in this lesson; it presumably refers to an earlier lesson's comparison, and a learner reading this lesson alone may not follow. Making it clear would mean adding content, so it is flagged, not changed.
